items.text: Iswamaete Besalel ka Okoliab, ka ninitunanan yenepinana kotau, yeneinakinit EJAKAIT acoa ka apirianut aijen aiswamaun aswam kere naka aijaanakin naka aibois nakalaunan, kwape ajaatar kere nuecorakinit EJAKAIT.”
Konyarau Musa Besalel ka Okoliab, ka ninirunanan yenepiriana kotau, yeneinakinit EJAKAIT acoa otauke, ninitunanan yenabu eketau kominakin abunore aswam:
Kijaasi Musa ainakineta kere, nuapotu idwe luka Isirael koyaut kanuka aswam naka aijaanakin naka aibois nakalaunan, aiswamaunia. Koyaununutu bobo mama ejai ŋesi ainakineta nuka akot ninitupuruc.
Ituŋa da lukacoa lueswamaete aswam kere naka aibois nakalaunan, kobu ŋinituŋanan kaswamuke naeswamaete kesi;
Kotemasi Musa atiar, “Eyaunete ituŋa luedeparito noi kanuka aijaanakin naka aswam, naecorakinit EJAKAIT aiswamaun.”
Kicorak Musa, kolimoroi da koidukurun kere ebe, “Sirikiyataki bobo ekiliokit arai aberu aswam kanuka ainakinet naka aibois nakalaunan.” Kwaŋin kitikokinai ituŋa ayaunun.
Naarai adolito iboro luajaatar kesi aiswamaunia aswam kere, kodeparito da.

Ŋinitunanan yenapiriana kotau ka nul kalueswamaete aswam kiswamau ewema lokalaunan kaigalisio atomon; nuka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim, ka lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, ka ikerubin, aswam naka ekeswaman kaloepiriana ŋes eswamaunia.
akaisaarei ka lukanykauni, ka alalauke ikubitin iwonon; aigalisio kere araas nuka aitemis adiopet.
Abu koropik aigalisio akany: koropik da aigalisio ace akany.
Abu kiswamak akodeta nubululu oreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kotoma kanuaropikinitai: kiswama kwaŋin koreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kotoma kanuce kanuaropikinitai.
Abu kiswamak akodeta akaisakany aigalisit adiopet kiswamak da akodeta akaisakany oreret loka aigalisit nakiareit naaropikinitai; kiteosi da akodeta nun.
Abu kiswamau aruceta akaisakany nuka esabu, kimorikik aigalisio karuceta: koraun do ewema ediopet lokalaunan.
Abu kiswamau aigalisio nuka ajul nuka akinei kanuka ewema lokokuju ewema lokalaunan: kiswamau aigalisio atomon ka nadiopet.
Aojau naka ŋiniigalisit ikubitin akaisauni, ka alalau naka niniigalisit ikubitin iwonon: araas aigalisio atomon ka nadiopet nuka aitemis adiopet.
Abu koropik aigalisio akany bonik, ka aigalisio nuce akanykape bonik.
Abu kiswamak akodeta akaisakany oreret loka aigalisit nakawasia kanun kanuaropikinitai, kiswamak da akodeta akaisakany oreret loka aigalisit nakawasia ka nuce kanuaropikinitai,
Abu kiswamau aruceta akaisakany nuka aisinit aimorikikinia ewema tetere eraun ediopet.
Abu kiswamau eimukoret loka ewema kimukulen luka imerekekin luitereŋitai, ka eimukoret loka imukulen luka itakasin kujuke.
Abu kiswamau abaoi nuka ewema lokalaunan kakito nuka sita, nuesipos.
Aojau naka abao arai ikubitin itomon, alalau naka ninibao arai ekubit ediopet ka atutubet.
Ŋinibao ajaas arucetake aarei nuarucokinito adiopet neajai nace: abu kiswamau kwaŋin abaoi kere nuka ewema lokalaunan.
Abu kiswamau abaoi nuka ewema lokalaunan; abaoi akaisaarei kowai loka eŋalakimak kari naka eŋalakimak:
Abu kiswamau aigaŋeta akaisaoŋon nuka epuesa kwap kabaoi akaisaarei; aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao adiopet neelomarete arucetake aarei, ka aigaŋeta aarei kwap kaeebao neelomarete arucetake aarei.
Kowai lokiareit loka ewema lokalaunan, kowai loka agolitomei, abu kiswamau abaoi akaisaarei,
Ka aigaŋetakec akaisaoŋon nuka epuesa; aigaŋeta aarei kwap kabao adiopet, ka aigaŋeta aarei kwap kacebao.
Abu kiswamau abaoi akanykape kowai lokokau kari nakoto.
Abu kiswamau abaoi aarei nuka agoria nuajaas to kewema lokalaunan.
Koraas aareiarei kokwap, kirotakina kwaŋin kiton kuiu ogilut ediopet: abu kiswamau kes kwaŋin kagoria kere aarei.
Ajaas abaoi akanykauni, ka aiganetakec nuka epuesa, aigaŋeta atomon ka nukanykape; kwap kaŋinibao aigaŋeta aarei.
Abu kiswamau ariino nuka akito nuka sita; akany nuka abaoi nukowai ediopet loka ewema,
Ka ariino ace akany nuka abaoi nukowai ece loka ewema, ka ariino akany nukoto kewema kari nakoto.
Abu kiriik ariit nakokidin naejai kidin kabaoi anyoun kepuai kiton epuai.
Kiladaa abaoi kesabu, kiswamak da igilunakec luka esabu lukitoloma ariino: kiladaa ariino kesabu.
Abu kiswamau aigalisit kegoe, kalobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim, icipakinio ikerubin ogoe aswam naka ekeswaman loepiriana, ŋes eswamaunia.
Abu kiswamak ipirin iwonon luka akito nuka sita, kiladaa kes kesabu: koraas igolunakec luka esabu: kotatak kes aigaŋeta nuka epuesa.
Abu kiswamau aigalisit naka ekek loka Ewema, lobululu, ka lomuge, ka lokarenan, ka ebaputa loecipitai kiusio lueriim, aswam naka ekasonyan.
Ka ipirinoke ikany ka igolunakec: kiladaa akwesikee ka aikajetakee kesabu: koraas aigaŋetakec akany nuka aisinit.
